calls.head: The Devils will send Kovacevic and Chisholm at Bjorkstrand
calls.body: At home, the Devils keep sending Kovacevic and Chisholm out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Sheldon Keefe has been picking a defense pair for opponents’ fourth lines. Tonight the Rangers’ fourth line is Bjorkstrand, Chmelař and Beaudoin.

surprises.head: The Rangers couldn’t get good looks
surprises.body: The Rangers usually get better looks than most teams. Not tonight: a 4.7% chance of scoring on the average shot at 5-on-5, against their usual 6.6% and a league average of 6.3%. A team strays this far about once every 25 games.

story.head: The Devils bury the Rangers
paras: An ugly night for the Rangers. Evan Rodrigues, Luke Hughes and Nico Hischier scored three goals in 4:38 late in the first to put the Devils up 3-0. Arseny Gritsyuk stretched the lead to 4-0, 31 seconds later. The Rangers pulled Dylan Garand after four goals and turned to Spencer Martin in the second. Luke Hughes scored again late in the second to make it 5-0 for the Devils. Stefan Noesen stretched the lead to 6-0 midway through the third. Pavel Dorofeyev got the Rangers on the board on the power play 1:01 later. Cody Glass made it 7-1 for the Devils shorthanded late in the third.

The Devils drove the play, outshooting the Rangers 31-19, and the scoreboard caught up. Nico Daws made 18 saves for the Devils. Nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Dougie Hamilton, by our Swing measure.
Will Cuylle and Johnathan Kovacevic fought midway through the first. Marcus Pettersson took three penalties on his own. The Devils moved to 4-3-0, and the Rangers fell to 6-3-0.
